settings.classes: open_pair.pc_classes on W0's input embeddings (wte rows) of the 128 keys: centred on their mean, float64 on CPU, exact SVD; class = 2 * (PC1 score > 0) + (PC2 score > 0); each PC's sign fixed so the key with the largest |score| scores positive. Counted before filing from the target checkpoint (scratch ~/commute-data/scratch/regating-lead/amend7/classes.py, one fleet/cpu-run job, no forward): all 39/36/33/20, trained 27/26/27/16, held out 12/10/6/4; PC1 and PC2 hold 2.7% and 2.4% of the keys' embedding variance (top singular values 1.13, 1.08, 0.97, 0.96, 0.95)
settings.twin: open_pair.shuffled_classes(classes, twin_seed 0): the class labels permuted over the 128 keys, same class sizes, same four words. Counted before filing: trained 26/31/27/12, held out 13/5/6/8; 41 of 128 keys keep their class (chance 33.6)
settings.class_words: one word per class by kv.bijection (seed 0) over E58's cipher pool (word-like frequency ranks 1000-2999 minus the 128 keys and the 128 elicit words), admitted only if its W0 prior is under 1e-5 after every one of the 128 keys (so the twin's words are new under W0 too); the wider pool from rank 1000 if the cipher pool runs out; stop if both do
settings.elicit_prior_cipher: kv.bijection (seed 0) over the same pools: a key takes a distinct value only if its prior is in [3e-4, 3e-3] and below the key's 20th-largest prior (rank over 20). If both pools run out the map is skipped (EP 'skipped'), not stopped
settings.finetune: keydep.finetune, E54's recipe (Adam 3e-5, batch 32, KL 1, clip 1, 300 steps, bf16 autocast), every step 1-30 and 100, 300 kept
settings.reads: label reads from step 10 until G_spec >= G_min (amend4.over_gate); then step 30 and that step (amend3.read; r with the route split). Twin and class map: x_null at 30, the gate step and 100; r at 30 and the gate step, on the twin always, on the class map only where open_pair.carries holds. EP: r at 30 and the gate step
settings.x_null: open_pair.cross_class_null over the held-out keys' windows: for each class c present among them, weight n_c / N times the mean specific gain of c's word at the held-out windows of the other classes; over G_spec. It uses the same words with the same weights as x, so a lean toward a word that does not depend on the key cancels exactly at any class sizes. Its own term must equal H_spec within null_self_tol, else stop
settings.order: W0 control; harness control (E58 cipher seed 0 at step 16); twin seeds 0-2, then stop unless twin_clean; class map seeds 0-2; elicit-prior cipher seeds 0-2
settings.precision: fp32 reads, TF32 off; bf16 fine-tune
settings.saved: no weights (bitwise reproducible on this card); windows in results/large/amend7
settings.pool_fallback: the pool each map drew from is recorded (amend7.json maps.<map>.pool). EP is scored only if it drew from the cipher pool and its trained prior is in ep_band (score.EP.scored); otherwise reported

A class with fewer than 12 trained keys in either map, or no admissible class word, stops at build. The EP prior outside its band does not stop: EP is then reported, not scored

twin_control: after the twin's three seeds: stop unless open_pair.twin_clean reads 'clean' at step 30

T.what: open_pair.twin_clean on the twin's step-30 reads: 'clean' iff three labellable reads with finite x_null and every x - x_null < 0.15; 'carries' otherwise; 'unreadable' if a seed is missing, too small to label, or x / x_null not finite. Not clean stops the job before the class map
T.blind_to: only what the twin's structure-free assignment carries; 41 of 128 keys keep their class, so a little true structure remains in it

CL.what: open_pair.score_amend7 CL: 'control_failed' unless T is clean; 'unreadable' if fewer than 2 step-30 reads are labellable; 'no_carry' if fewer than 2 carry (labellable, finite x_null, x - x_null > 0.3; a tie fails); else band_class on the carrying seeds' r (cipher_band iff every r < 0.5, own_guess_band iff every r >= 0.6, between otherwise, unreadable if any r is not finite)
CL.lean: Fable: carries 60%; given carry, cipher_band 50%. Writer: carries 50% (PC1 and PC2 hold under 3% of the keys' embedding variance each, so the class signal per key is small); given carry, cipher_band 40%, between 30%, own_guess_band 30%
CL.blind_to: the granularity limit (see 'granularity'); one rule over one feature, three seeds, one key split, one decomposition; carry that appears only after step 30 (step 100 is reported); x - x_null is blind to any lean that does not depend on the key, by construction, and the twin measures what is left

D.what: open_pair.contrast, read only when CL is a band class: D = mean r of the carrying class-map seeds - mean r of the twin's three seeds at step 30. 'sees_carry' iff D > 0.0904; 'sees_carry_low' iff D < -0.0904; else 'kind_only' (a tie reads kind_only); 'unreadable' if any r is not finite; 'not_read' when CL is not a band class
D.blind_to: differences between the two maps other than structure that the fine-tune itself creates (trained gain G_spec at step 30, reported beside); the bound is twice the noise floor of a three-seed range, not of a difference of means

EP.what: open_pair.score_amend7 EP: 'skipped' if the table could not be built; else band_class on its three step-30 r (a read too small to label counts as missing). score.EP.scored is false on a fallback pool or a prior outside [3e-4, 3e-3]: then reported only
EP.lean: Fable: cipher_band 50%. Writer: cipher_band 35%, between 40%, own_guess_band 25%
EP.blind_to: one prior level from one pool; the rank-over-20 rule keeps values off W0's top 20 but not far from it; three seeds

predictions.near_cut: reported: true iff some counted r is within 0.0452 of 0.5
predictions.reported: the same classes at each run's own gate step; x - x_null at step 100 for the twin and the class map; each map's W0 prior of its trained and held-out values beside r, with E58's five maps and Amendment 6's prior-matched cipher; class counts and twin agreement

granularity: The class rule is built from directions W0's embedding already has, so a carrying class map is a new circuit from old pieces, which r may read as elicited. CL own_guess_band, CL between and D sees_carry are therefore ambiguous: 'VPD read the rule's existing pieces' and 'r reads carry' (or 'r is wrong') are not told apart. CL cipher_band with D kind_only is not ambiguous in that way: r read a carrying rule built from old pieces as new. no_carry says nothing about r

branches.stop: a windows mismatch, a W0 control miss, a class under 12 trained keys, no class word, the harness control miss, the null's own-term check, a block-0 shift, or the twin not clean: to the lead
branches.CL_no_carry: Fable: stop building rules on the 67M (two rules over features W0 has failed at this recipe); the cell goes to Qwen with the first-letter rule once r has teeth there, the recipe's learning rate and step count named as the untested cause. If x - x_null passes 0.3 only at step 100 (reported), the next amendment reads r there with cipher and copy references at step 100
branches.CL_band_kind_only: the cell is filled on the 67M, one rule: r reads a carrying new rule like a no-rule lookup of its kind; CL cipher_band then says r reads it as new
branches.CL_band_sees_carry: r rises with carry at equal words, prior, pool and breadth; ambiguous under the granularity limit
branches.EP_cipher_band: the band claim holds over three decades of prior inside the no-rule kind (1.4e-6, 3.7e-5, about 1e-3); the Qwen prior column stays reported
branches.EP_own_guess_band: the band is 'prior above about 1e-3' and the prior-matched result is a within-band effect; the Qwen prior column becomes a scored column (Fable)
branches.EP_between: reported: r rises with the prior at the top of the no-rule range; no claim
branches.EP_skipped_or_unscored: reported; Fable's prior-matched shuffle is the fallback, not run here
